# Leben in Deutschland

## Overview
This site provides a free, ad-free resource for learners preparing for the German citizenship exam and the Leben in Deutschland test.

## Key pages
- https://lebenindeutschland2027.de/
- https://lebenindeutschland2027.de/about/
- https://lebenindeutschland2027.de/practice/
- https://lebenindeutschland2027.de/german-citizenship-test/
- https://lebenindeutschland2027.de/leben-in-deutschland-practice/
- https://lebenindeutschland2027.de/study-guide/
- https://lebenindeutschland2027.de/how-to-prepare/
- https://lebenindeutschland2027.de/berlin-appointment-guide/
- https://lebenindeutschland2027.de/faq/
- https://lebenindeutschland2027.de/support/
- https://lebenindeutschland2027.de/appstore-reviews/
- https://lebenindeutschland2027.de/privacy-policy/
- https://lebenindeutschland2027.de/terms-and-conditions/

## Topics covered
- Free Leben in Deutschland practice
- German citizenship exam preparation
- Study guide and mock-test preparation
- Berlin appointment and official process guidance
- FAQ and support for learners
- App Store reviews and user feedback

## Important note
This project is a free study resource designed to support learners preparing for the German citizenship exam and the Life in Germany test. It is not an official BAMF or government publication.
